results.description:
Enemies to lovers: Fugitive Hacker Heroine's Last Hope.

"I'm the only one of the two of us who hasn't broken every written law, who's the more trustworthy here?"

Whatever it takes, Aurora Maguire must complete her mission to find her friend and save his life.

After exhausting every other option, she's left with only one hope.

Exile.

A man with no country.

No loyalty to anyone but himself.

Aurora endangers the life of the skilled criminal when she drops his name to her enemy. If she's going down, then Exile will go down with her.

He seethes while she teases.

Danger and duplicity are the least of their worries. Neither are prepared for the gravity of what happens when their lives collide and they're forced to depend on each other.

Warning: Contains explicit language and imagery. Suitable only for ages 18 and over.
